args.sql:
SELECT 
    df.flowtag AS "Flow ID",
    rm.riskassess AS "Risk Score",
    dp.datasense AS "Data Sensitivity"
FROM 
    DataFlow df
JOIN 
    RiskManagement rm ON df.recordregistry = rm.flowlink
JOIN 
    DataProfile dp ON rm.risktrace = dp.riskjoin
ORDER BY 
    dp.datasense;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    df.flowtag AS "Flow ID",
    rm.riskassess AS "Risk Score",
    dp.datasense AS "Data Sensitivity"
FROM 
    DataFlow df
JOIN 
    RiskManagement rm ON df.recordregistry = rm.flowlink
JOIN 
    DataProfile dp ON rm.risktrace = dp.riskjoin
ORDER BY 
    dp.datasense;
